title: Keyboard Walkthroughs & Screen Readers
objectives: Use a screen reader for basic smoke checks

examples.name: keyboard-audit.txt
examples.code:
keyboard audit script (10 minutes per page)
1. Tab from the address bar: is every control reachable in order?
2. Is focus ALWAYS visible?
3. Enter/Space activate the focused control?
4. Escape closes overlays?
5. Any keyboard trap that is not a modal?

screen reader smoke test (NVDA / VoiceOver)
- headings list makes sense
- forms announce label + error
- buttons announce their name (not "button button")

exercise.prompt: Classify each audit finding: "focus invisible on dark theme" (focus visibility), "cannot reach footer links with Tab" (keyboard reachability), "button announces as button button" (accessible name), "text contrast 2.9:1" (contrast).
hints: WCAG AA contrast is 4.5:1 for normal text.
Accessible names come from content/labels, not tag names.

questions.prompt: The minimum viable a11y test anyone can run is…
options: unplug the mouse and use the app keyboard-only
questions.explanation: A keyboard walkthrough finds the majority of structural failures in minutes.

questions.prompt: AA contrast for body text is…
questions.explanation: 4.5:1 for normal text; 3:1 for large text.
